units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	They lead you to one of the smaller transport gates at the spaceport, where a compact train snakes away from the city and into a remarkably pristine countryside. Eventually your guide leads you off the train; the station overlooks a large coastal depression where thousands of other Successors have gathered on semicircular benches around a central tank situated at the edge of the sea. Several of the benches have been built up into small but richly adorned boxes where, presumably, the wealthiest members of the audience can enjoy the show in privacy.|230|0
units.english: They lead you to one of the smaller transport gates at the spaceport, where a compact train snakes away from the city and into a remarkably pristine countryside. Eventually your guide leads you off the train; the station overlooks a large coastal depression where thousands of other Successors have gathered on semicircular benches around a central tank situated at the edge of the sea. Several of the benches have been built up into small but richly adorned boxes where, presumably, the wealthiest members of the audience can enjoy the show in privacy.
units.italian: Vi conducono a una delle porte di trasporto più piccole dello spazioporto, dove un treno compatto serpeggia fuori dalla città e dentro una campagna straordinariamente intatta. Alla fine la guida vi fa scendere; la stazione domina una grande depressione costiera dove migliaia di altri Successori si sono radunati su panche semicircolari attorno a una vasca centrale posta sul bordo del mare. Alcune panche sono state rialzate a formare piccoli palchi riccamente adornati, dove presumibilmente i membri più facoltosi del pubblico possono godersi lo spettacolo in privato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	You sit down, and after several minutes one Successor gives a brief introduction. It begins with thanking the local House for funding the event, continues into naming and introducing each of the lead actors, and finishes with a curious ritual in which each of the actors is given a small decorative token by the show's organizer. The actors thread these onto long strings that they carry - several of them already have highly-adorned strings that they loop several times over their bodies.|231|0
units.english: You sit down, and after several minutes one Successor gives a brief introduction. It begins with thanking the local House for funding the event, continues into naming and introducing each of the lead actors, and finishes with a curious ritual in which each of the actors is given a small decorative token by the show's organizer. The actors thread these onto long strings that they carry - several of them already have highly-adorned strings that they loop several times over their bodies.
units.italian: Vi sedete e, dopo alcuni minuti, un Successore pronuncia una breve introduzione. Comincia ringraziando la Casata locale per aver finanziato l'evento, prosegue nominando e presentando ciascuno degli attori principali e si chiude con uno strano rituale in cui l'organizzatore dello spettacolo consegna a ogni attore un piccolo contrassegno decorativo. Gli attori li infilano su lunghi fili che portano con sé: diversi di loro hanno già fili molto adorni, che si avvolgono più volte attorno al corpo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"Myiara! How long we've been unseeing of thy tender face among our number! Return, and grace us so," cries a player within the tank, their voice amplified for the audience. Several others gyre around them, each wearing detailed, colorful masks, each one echoing "Myiara!" as the first speaker continues. Still more players enter from apertures in the tank's bottom, swimming up to the surface, where they pop into the air with acrobatic elegance before landing on the tank's clear top.|232|0
units.english: "Myiara! How long we've been unseeing of thy tender face among our number! Return, and grace us so," cries a player within the tank, their voice amplified for the audience. Several others gyre around them, each wearing detailed, colorful masks, each one echoing "Myiara!" as the first speaker continues. Still more players enter from apertures in the tank's bottom, swimming up to the surface, where they pop into the air with acrobatic elegance before landing on the tank's clear top.
units.italian: "Myiara! Da quanto tempo non vediamo il tuo volto gentile fra noi! Torna, e concedici questa grazia", grida un attore dentro la vasca, la voce amplificata per il pubblico. Diversi altri gli roteano attorno, ognuno con una maschera dettagliata e colorata, e ognuno riecheggia "Myiara!" mentre il primo parla. Altri attori ancora entrano da aperture sul fondo della vasca, risalgono a nuoto fino alla superficie e schizzano in aria con eleganza acrobatica prima di atterrare sul coperchio trasparente della vasca.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"The Myiaran sort will never know their kind again," one says, their outfit and skin alike changing color to a rich blue. "For nobly we are not, nor never will..."|233|0
units.english: "The Myiaran sort will never know their kind again," one says, their outfit and skin alike changing color to a rich blue. "For nobly we are not, nor never will..."
units.italian: "I Miarani non rivedranno mai più la loro gente", dice uno, mentre abito e pelle cambiano insieme colore diventando di un blu intenso. "Perché nobili non siamo, né mai lo saremo..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	(Pay attention.)|235|0
units.english: (Pay attention.)
units.italian: (Fa' attenzione.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	(Let my mind wander.)|237|0
units.english: (Let my mind wander.)
units.italian: (Lascia che la mente vaghi.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	(Leave early.)|239|0
units.english: (Leave early.)
units.italian: (Vattene prima.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	You stay until the first intermission - still an uncomfortably long wait, and as far as you can tell, the story is nowhere near complete at that point. The performance was distinctly alien, with masks, acrobatics, and a stunning moment midway through the first act where one of the characters conjured up a storm to afflict another. Huge globs of water, suspended in clear spheres, were lifted behind the stage by some sort of repulsor mechanism.|240|0
units.english: You stay until the first intermission - still an uncomfortably long wait, and as far as you can tell, the story is nowhere near complete at that point. The performance was distinctly alien, with masks, acrobatics, and a stunning moment midway through the first act where one of the characters conjured up a storm to afflict another. Huge globs of water, suspended in clear spheres, were lifted behind the stage by some sort of repulsor mechanism.
units.italian: Restate fino al primo intervallo: un'attesa comunque scomodamente lunga, e per quanto possiate giudicare la storia è ancora lontanissima dalla conclusione. Lo spettacolo è decisamente alieno, con maschere, acrobazie e un momento sbalorditivo a metà del primo atto, quando uno dei personaggi evoca una tempesta per colpirne un altro. Enormi masse d'acqua, sospese in sfere trasparenti, venivano sollevate dietro il palco da una specie di meccanismo a repulsione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	The train silently arrives after only a few minutes of waiting and takes you back to the spaceport without issue.|241|0
units.english: The train silently arrives after only a few minutes of waiting and takes you back to the spaceport without issue.
units.italian: Il treno arriva in silenzio dopo solo qualche minuto di attesa e vi riporta allo spazioporto senza problemi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"Irja, go and spread thine arms! Listen for our heart's yearning call, their voice, if thine ears can but hear at all what little flutt'rings a mortal life doth make..."|244|0
units.english: "Irja, go and spread thine arms! Listen for our heart's yearning call, their voice, if thine ears can but hear at all what little flutt'rings a mortal life doth make..."
units.italian: "Irja, va' e apri le tue braccia! Ascolta il richiamo anelante del nostro cuore, la sua voce, se le tue orecchie riescono a percepire i piccoli palpiti che una vita mortale produce..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	The play turns out to be remarkably long, and immensely complex. The plot follows both mortal Successors, on the dry stage, and the gods in the water beneath them. Myiara Raaja was the adoptive child of one of the gods, eternally youthful in their immortal realm, but who ran away to the mortal world while the gods slumbered. There, they lived a long and full life before eventually dying and leaving behind their only child, Myiara Sera. The awakened gods, lamenting the loss of their child, dispatch their messenger Irja to retrieve the elder Myiara from the world above, but Irja, blinded by joy, mistakes the younger Myiara Sera for Myiara Raaja. In a desperate show of wit, Myiara Sera manages to poison Irja with a draught of eternal sleep, smearing it on a fine cloak that the god cannot resist, thinking it to be a reunion gift from their long-lost child.|245|0
units.english: The play turns out to be remarkably long, and immensely complex. The plot follows both mortal Successors, on the dry stage, and the gods in the water beneath them. Myiara Raaja was the adoptive child of one of the gods, eternally youthful in their immortal realm, but who ran away to the mortal world while the gods slumbered. There, they lived a long and full life before eventually dying and leaving behind their only child, Myiara Sera. The awakened gods, lamenting the loss of their child, dispatch their messenger Irja to retrieve the elder Myiara from the world above, but Irja, blinded by joy, mistakes the younger Myiara Sera for Myiara Raaja. In a desperate show of wit, Myiara Sera manages to poison Irja with a draught of eternal sleep, smearing it on a fine cloak that the god cannot resist, thinking it to be a reunion gift from their long-lost child.
units.italian: Lo spettacolo si rivela straordinariamente lungo e immensamente complesso. La trama segue sia i Successori mortali, sul palco asciutto, sia gli dèi nell'acqua sotto di loro. Myiara Raaja era la creatura adottiva di uno degli dèi, eternamente giovane nel regno immortale, ma fuggì nel mondo dei mortali mentre gli dèi dormivano. Lì visse una vita lunga e piena, finché alla fine morì lasciando dietro di sé Myiara Sera, la propria unica creatura. Gli dèi, destatisi, lamentano la perdita e mandano il messaggero Irja a riprendere Myiara Raaja dal mondo di sopra; ma Irja, accecato dalla gioia, scambia la giovane Myiara Sera per Myiara Raaja. In un disperato sfoggio di astuzia, Myiara Sera riesce ad avvelenare Irja con una bevanda di sonno eterno, spalmandola su un mantello pregiato a cui il dio non sa resistere, convinto che sia un dono di ricongiungimento dalla creatura perduta da tanto tempo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	To maintain their freedom, Myiara Sera descends into the immortal world, tearfully poisoning each of the gods one-by-one in a similar fashion, eventually leaving them as they began - slumbering, caught in the slow gyration of the undersea currents. By the epilogue, Myiara Sera has two children themself, one who remains forever with the gods, coaxing them into ever-deeper dreamful sleep, the other who lives on in the mortal world and gives rise to a family of heroes, each of whom have their own plays and other cultural products.|246|0
units.english: To maintain their freedom, Myiara Sera descends into the immortal world, tearfully poisoning each of the gods one-by-one in a similar fashion, eventually leaving them as they began - slumbering, caught in the slow gyration of the undersea currents. By the epilogue, Myiara Sera has two children themself, one who remains forever with the gods, coaxing them into ever-deeper dreamful sleep, the other who lives on in the mortal world and gives rise to a family of heroes, each of whom have their own plays and other cultural products.
units.italian: Per conservare la propria libertà, Myiara Sera scende nel regno immortale e, in lacrime, avvelena uno per uno gli dèi allo stesso modo, lasciandoli infine come erano all'inizio: dormienti, avvolti nella lenta rotazione delle correnti sottomarine. Nell'epilogo Myiara Sera ha a sua volta due figli: uno resta per sempre con gli dèi, convincendoli a un sonno sempre più profondo e popolato di sogni; l'altro vive nel mondo dei mortali e dà origine a una famiglia di eroi, ognuno dei quali ha i propri spettacoli e altri prodotti culturali.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"This one shall linger, unmaligned, insensate, in the sepulchre'f of the deep. And all the weeping masses 'bove, below shall in their memory keep, and render off'rings...|247|0
units.english: "This one shall linger, unmaligned, insensate, in the sepulchre'f of the deep. And all the weeping masses 'bove, below shall in their memory keep, and render off'rings...
units.italian: "Questo resterà, incontaminato, insensato, nel sepolcro degli abissi. E tutte le moltitudini in lacrime, sopra e sotto, ne serberanno memoria e offriranno doni...

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	The production of the performance is strikingly alien - each of the actors wears a complex mask of their character that articulates with their face beneath it. The masks of the mortal characters are straightforward, if expressive, but those of the gods are enormous and dramatic. Many have long, ribbony parts that never settle in the currents of the tank, constantly swirling around the heads of the actors.|248|0
units.english: The production of the performance is strikingly alien - each of the actors wears a complex mask of their character that articulates with their face beneath it. The masks of the mortal characters are straightforward, if expressive, but those of the gods are enormous and dramatic. Many have long, ribbony parts that never settle in the currents of the tank, constantly swirling around the heads of the actors.
units.italian: La messa in scena è sorprendentemente aliena: ogni attore indossa una maschera complessa del proprio personaggio, che si muove insieme al volto sotto di essa. Le maschere dei personaggi mortali sono semplici, anche se espressive; quelle degli dèi sono enormi e drammatiche. Molte hanno lunghe appendici a nastro che non si posano mai nelle correnti della vasca e ruotano continuamente attorno alla testa degli attori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	Characters jump between the mortal and immortal realms by acrobatic leaps between the water-filled tank and its mostly-dry top surface. When particular moments are meant to be highlighted, enormous splashes of water erupt from behind the stage, and during others, long strands of the writhing Successor metal rise from around it, forming forests, ocean waves, and terrible storms out of their gleaming lengths.|249|0
units.english: Characters jump between the mortal and immortal realms by acrobatic leaps between the water-filled tank and its mostly-dry top surface. When particular moments are meant to be highlighted, enormous splashes of water erupt from behind the stage, and during others, long strands of the writhing Successor metal rise from around it, forming forests, ocean waves, and terrible storms out of their gleaming lengths.
units.italian: I personaggi passano dal regno mortale a quello immortale con salti acrobatici fra la vasca piena d'acqua e la sua superficie superiore quasi asciutta. Nei momenti che devono essere sottolineati, enormi schizzi d'acqua erompono da dietro il palco; in altri, lunghi filamenti del metallo guizzante dei Successori si sollevano tutt'intorno, formando foreste, onde marine e tempeste spaventose con le loro lunghezze lucenti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"Myiara younger, elder, younger still, who each shakes us from our rest to let us feel it sour again in the oceans of our blood..."|250|0
units.english: "Myiara younger, elder, younger still, who each shakes us from our rest to let us feel it sour again in the oceans of our blood..."
units.italian: "Myiara giovane, anziana, ancora giovane, ognuna ci scuote dal riposo per farci sentire di nuovo l'amaro negli oceani del nostro sangue..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	By the time it's over, you are thoroughly exhausted from the experience. The train arrives after only a few minutes of waiting and you, packed in along with many other Successors, make your way back to the spaceport, finally arriving late in the night.|251|0
units.english: By the time it's over, you are thoroughly exhausted from the experience. The train arrives after only a few minutes of waiting and you, packed in along with many other Successors, make your way back to the spaceport, finally arriving late in the night.
units.italian: Quando finisce, siete completamente esausti per l'esperienza. Il treno arriva dopo solo pochi minuti di attesa e voi, stipati insieme a molti altri Successori, tornate verso lo spazioporto, arrivando infine a notte fonda.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	The play turns out to be remarkably long, and inscrutably complex. The plot seems to follow both mortal Successors, on the dry stage, and the gods in the water beneath them. One character named Myiara was beloved by the gods, and another one, seemingly misidentified, takes on the extensive process of one-by-one poisoning each of the gods so that their secret isn't found out. Eventually they have their own children, one of whom remains in the realm of the gods, and the other who returns to the world of the living.|254|0
units.english: The play turns out to be remarkably long, and inscrutably complex. The plot seems to follow both mortal Successors, on the dry stage, and the gods in the water beneath them. One character named Myiara was beloved by the gods, and another one, seemingly misidentified, takes on the extensive process of one-by-one poisoning each of the gods so that their secret isn't found out. Eventually they have their own children, one of whom remains in the realm of the gods, and the other who returns to the world of the living.
units.italian: Lo spettacolo si rivela straordinariamente lungo e incomprensibilmente complesso. La trama sembra seguire sia i Successori mortali, sul palco asciutto, sia gli dèi nell'acqua sotto di loro. Un personaggio di nome Myiara era la beniamina degli dèi, e un altro, apparentemente scambiato per lei, intraprende il lungo lavoro di avvelenare uno per uno tutti gli dèi perché il suo segreto non venga scoperto. Alla fine ha dei figli: uno resta nel regno degli dèi, l'altro torna nel mondo dei vivi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	The production itself is eye-catching - the actors wear impressive masks that articulate with their faces, heightening the emotions they intend to portray. At particular moments in the story, enormous splashes of water erupt from behind the stage, and during others, long strands of metal are coaxed upwards into suspended shapes, forming scenes of storms and forests above the players' heads.|255|0
units.english: The production itself is eye-catching - the actors wear impressive masks that articulate with their faces, heightening the emotions they intend to portray. At particular moments in the story, enormous splashes of water erupt from behind the stage, and during others, long strands of metal are coaxed upwards into suspended shapes, forming scenes of storms and forests above the players' heads.
units.italian: La messa in scena è di per sé notevole: gli attori indossano maschere imponenti che si muovono insieme ai loro volti, esaltando le emozioni che intendono rappresentare. In certi momenti della storia enormi schizzi d'acqua erompono da dietro il palco, in altri lunghi filamenti di metallo vengono fatti salire in forme sospese, creando scene di tempesta e di foresta sopra la testa degli attori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	By the time it's over, you are thoroughly exhausted from the experience. The train arrives after only a few minutes of waiting and you, packed in along with many other Successors, make your way back to the spaceport, finally arriving late in the night.|256|0
units.english: By the time it's over, you are thoroughly exhausted from the experience. The train arrives after only a few minutes of waiting and you, packed in along with many other Successors, make your way back to the spaceport, finally arriving late in the night.
units.italian: Quando finisce, siete completamente esausti per l'esperienza. Il treno arriva dopo solo pochi minuti di attesa e voi, stipati insieme a molti altri Successori, tornate verso lo spazioporto, arrivando infine a notte fonda.

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|Soon after you disembark your ship, you spot two Successors eyeing you from across the spaceport; the younger one pulls at the arms of the larger one several times until eventually the two of them move over to you. The larger one splays their arms in greeting. "My child wanted me to ask of thee, alien - in thy travels, hast thou met a Sosrue?|269|0
units.english: Soon after you disembark your ship, you spot two Successors eyeing you from across the spaceport; the younger one pulls at the arms of the larger one several times until eventually the two of them move over to you. The larger one splays their arms in greeting. "My child wanted me to ask of thee, alien - in thy travels, hast thou met a Sosrue?
units.italian: Poco dopo che siete scesi dalla nave, notate due Successori che vi osservano dall'altra parte dello spazioporto; il più giovane tira più volte le braccia del più grande finché i due non si avvicinano a voi. Il più grande apre le braccia in segno di saluto. "Mio figlio voleva che te lo chiedessi, alieno: nei tuoi viaggi hai mai incontrato un Sosrue?

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"A what?"|271|0
units.english: "A what?"
units.italian: "Un che?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"Maybe, but I wouldn't know it by that name if I had."|273|0
units.english: "Maybe, but I wouldn't know it by that name if I had."
units.italian: "Forse, ma se l'avessi incontrato non lo saprei con quel nome."

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"I don't have time for this."|275|0
units.english: "I don't have time for this."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo per questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	The adult affects what might be a disappointed shade of red, but nonetheless collects their child and leaves you alone to your business.|276|0
units.english: The adult affects what might be a disappointed shade of red, but nonetheless collects their child and leaves you alone to your business.
units.italian: L'adulto assume quella che potrebbe essere una tonalità di rosso delusa, ma prende comunque con sé il figlio e vi lascia ai vostri affari.

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	The child bursts into speech. "Beware the Sosrue, cloaked in black, its teeth and claws!" before their parent interrupts them.|279|0
units.english: The child bursts into speech. "Beware the Sosrue, cloaked in black, its teeth and claws!" before their parent interrupts them.
units.italian: Il piccolo prorompe in un discorso concitato. "Attento al Sosrue, vestito di nero, con i suoi denti e i suoi artigli!" prima che il genitore lo interrompa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"I'm sorry," says the adult. "It's a monster, from a children's poem. This little's favorite. So tell my child and I, also - hast thou, among the wider breadth of stars, met some creature long of arm, discerning of ear, and many of tooth, that dwells in every manner of the stellar deep?" Their skin runs with thin golden lines as they say this, shivering with each syllable.|281|0
units.english: "I'm sorry," says the adult. "It's a monster, from a children's poem. This little's favorite. So tell my child and I, also - hast thou, among the wider breadth of stars, met some creature long of arm, discerning of ear, and many of tooth, that dwells in every manner of the stellar deep?" Their skin runs with thin golden lines as they say this, shivering with each syllable.
units.italian: "Mi scuso", dice l'adulto. "È un mostro, da una poesia per bambini. Il preferito di questo piccolo. Allora racconta anche a me e a mio figlio: fra le distese più ampie delle stelle, hai mai incontrato una creatura dalle lunghe braccia, dall'orecchio fine e dai molti denti, che abita ogni genere di abisso stellare?" Mentre parla, la pelle gli si riga di sottili linee dorate che tremano a ogni sillaba.

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"No, but I've met some interesting aliens."|283|0
units.english: "No, but I've met some interesting aliens."
units.italian: "No, ma ho incontrato alieni interessanti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"I once wrestled one deep in a nebula."|285|0
units.english: "I once wrestled one deep in a nebula."
units.italian: "Una volta ho lottato con una, in fondo a una nebulosa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"That's an awfully dark story for a child."|287|0
units.english: "That's an awfully dark story for a child."
units.italian: "È una storia terribilmente cupa per un bambino."

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	The child undulates gently, burbling with strange laughter. "'Tis not real," says their parent. "Why would my child be afeared by it?"|288|0
units.english: The child undulates gently, burbling with strange laughter. "'Tis not real," says their parent. "Why would my child be afeared by it?"
units.italian: Il piccolo ondeggia piano, gorgogliando una risata strana. "Non è vero", dice il genitore. "Perché mio figlio dovrebbe averne paura?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	With this, the two Successors glide back into the spaceport, chatting with each other as they go.|289|0
units.english: With this, the two Successors glide back into the spaceport, chatting with each other as they go.
units.italian: Detto questo, i due Successori scivolano di nuovo nello spazioporto, chiacchierando fra loro mentre si allontanano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	The child wriggles gently as if laughing, turning a pastel shade of pink. "So serious, thou art," their parent says. "Perhaps thy alien companions did all the Sosrue-seeing before thou came. They must be witty ones to have escaped with their lives!"|292|0
units.english: The child wriggles gently as if laughing, turning a pastel shade of pink. "So serious, thou art," their parent says. "Perhaps thy alien companions did all the Sosrue-seeing before thou came. They must be witty ones to have escaped with their lives!"
units.italian: Il piccolo si dimena piano come se ridesse, assumendo una tonalità di rosa pastello. "Quanto sei serio", dice il genitore. "Forse i tuoi compagni alieni hanno già visto tutti i Sosrue prima che arrivassi tu. Devono essere spiritosi, per essere scampati con la vita!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	With this, the two depart back into the spaceport, clearly having fulfilled whatever impulse toward amusement they came to you for.|293|0
units.english: With this, the two depart back into the spaceport, clearly having fulfilled whatever impulse toward amusement they came to you for.
units.italian: Detto questo, i due si allontanano di nuovo nello spazioporto, avendo chiaramente soddisfatto quel bisogno di divertimento che li aveva portati da voi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	"Thy wounds!" the child cries, "and by this, half thy arms have been divorced from thee!" They wiggle happily, and their parent continues, the golden lines from before bursting into splashes of color all over their body. "Thou must have been a witty one to have escaped this. No doubt thy foe remains in wait, now knowing of thy might. Thou must be twice as clever should you ever meet again!"|296|0
units.english: "Thy wounds!" the child cries, "and by this, half thy arms have been divorced from thee!" They wiggle happily, and their parent continues, the golden lines from before bursting into splashes of color all over their body. "Thou must have been a witty one to have escaped this. No doubt thy foe remains in wait, now knowing of thy might. Thou must be twice as clever should you ever meet again!"
units.italian: "Le tue ferite!" esclama il piccolo, "e così metà delle tue braccia sono state separate da te!" Si dimena felice, e il genitore prosegue, mentre le linee dorate di prima esplodono in chiazze di colore su tutto il suo corpo. "Devi essere stato spiritoso per scamparla. Senza dubbio il tuo nemico è ancora in agguato, ora che conosce la tua forza. Dovrai essere due volte più astuto, se mai vi incontrerete di nuovo!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Sosrue|	With this final comment, the parent once again splays their arms to you and the two Successors glide back into the spaceport, the child murmuring more of the poem as they go.|297|0

units.italian: Dopo quest'ultimo commento, il genitore apre di nuovo le braccia verso di voi e i due Successori scivolano via nello spazioporto, con il piccolo che mormora ancora versi della poesia.

units.english: Although the spaceport here is as quiet and lifeless as always, when you disembark for a moment, you spy a strange, colorful object lying a short distance away in the gloom. It's hard to tell what exactly it is at first glance, but upon closer inspection, it appears to be a small metal model of a Kvelqde shuttle, painted in bright and oily-looking colors. A tiny, well-worn propeller emerges from its rear.
units.italian: Anche se lo spazioporto qui è silenzioso e senza vita come sempre, quando scendete per un momento scorgete un oggetto strano e colorato che giace a poca distanza nel buio. A prima vista è difficile dire che cosa sia, ma guardando meglio sembra un piccolo modello in metallo di una navetta Kvelqde, dipinto con colori vivaci dall'aspetto oleoso. Dal retro spunta una minuscola elica, molto consumata.

units.id: mission:Successors: Armor Reconfiguration|As you look around the spaceport here, a High Houses warship comes in for a landing, proceeding into a smaller outfitting bay off to the side that is only partially visible to civilian viewers. Enormous mechanical arms fold down from the top of the bay, first calibrating themselves against the vessel's shape and position before starting to scan over the warship's armor closely enough that it looks like they are almost touching. The metal writhes as the arms pass over it - goopy, liquid-looking protrusions form and collapse in their wake, splashing into themselves like raindrops into water, dewy and soft. Once the rippling stops, the texture of the hull looks somehow changed: a little rougher, perhaps, or maybe a slightly different shade of gray. The ship takes off not long after.|351|0
units.english: As you look around the spaceport here, a High Houses warship comes in for a landing, proceeding into a smaller outfitting bay off to the side that is only partially visible to civilian viewers. Enormous mechanical arms fold down from the top of the bay, first calibrating themselves against the vessel's shape and position before starting to scan over the warship's armor closely enough that it looks like they are almost touching. The metal writhes as the arms pass over it - goopy, liquid-looking protrusions form and collapse in their wake, splashing into themselves like raindrops into water, dewy and soft. Once the rippling stops, the texture of the hull looks somehow changed: a little rougher, perhaps, or maybe a slightly different shade of gray. The ship takes off not long after.
units.italian: Mentre vi guardate intorno nello spazioporto, una nave da guerra delle Alte Casate si avvicina per atterrare e prosegue verso un piccolo hangar di allestimento laterale, solo in parte visibile agli sguardi dei civili. Enormi bracci meccanici si abbassano dalla sommità dell'hangar, si calibrano prima sulla forma e sulla posizione del vascello, poi cominciano a scorrere sull'armatura della nave tanto da vicino che sembra quasi la tocchino. Il metallo guizza al passaggio dei bracci: protuberanze viscide dall'aspetto liquido si formano e si richiudono sulla loro scia, schizzando in sé stesse come gocce di pioggia nell'acqua, rugiadose e morbide. Quando l'increspatura si ferma, la trama dello scafo appare in qualche modo cambiata: un po' più ruvida, forse, o di una tonalità di grigio leggermente diversa. La nave decolla poco dopo.
